newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan overnights down on excess liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan overnights down on excess liquidity.

text.p: Pakistan's money rates fell on Saturday amid surplus liquidity and dealers said they expected overnight rates to remain depressed when the market reopens after the Sunday weekend.
"Once again the week ended on a liquid note," a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank said. He said trading was dull and overnight deals were struck at one to two percent.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan has announced an auction of six-month short term federal bonds for next week.
